name: v2_release
title: v2.0 Major Release with Breaking API Changes
description: Major version release introducing a new plugin architecture, migrating from UIKit to SwiftUI for all screens, deprecating 12 public APIs, and adding support for iPadOS multitasking. Includes data migration from CoreData to SwiftData, production readiness checklist, and rollback plan.

requirements.description: Migrate all 8 screens from UIKit to SwiftUI with feature parity
Implement plugin architecture with dynamic loading and sandboxing
CoreData to SwiftData migration with zero data loss
Deprecate 12 public APIs with migration guide and compiler warnings
iPadOS Split View and Slide Over support
Production readiness checklist covering monitoring, alerting, and rollback
App launch time must not regress beyond 10% from v1.x baseline
Automated rollback mechanism if crash rate exceeds 1% in first 24 hours
Beta testing phase of minimum 2 weeks with 500+ users
Documentation update for all changed public APIs

constraints: Migration must be reversible for 30 days post-release
No feature flags in production release build
